Verses.1: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
Verses.2: This Mary was the one who anointed the Lord with perfume and wiped His feet with her hair. Her brother Lazarus was sick.
Verses.3: So the sisters send word to Him, saying, "Lord, behold, the one whom You love is sick."
Verses.4: After Jesus heard this, He said, "This sickness will not end in death. It is for God's glory, so that God's Son may be glorified by it."
Verses.5: Now, Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.
Verses.6: When He head that Lazarus was sick, He then stayed where he was for two more days.
Verses.7: After this, He said to the disciples, "Let's go back to Judea."
Verses.8: The disciples said to Him, "Rabbi, just now there were Jews seeking to stone You! And yet, You are going back?"
Verses.9: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If someone walks during the day, they don't stumble, because they see by the light of this world.
Verses.10: But, if anyone walks at night they stumble because they are without light."
Verses.11: After this, He said to them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to awaken him."
Verses.12: The disciples replied, "Lord, if he sleeps, he will recover."
Verses.13: Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that He meant actual sleep.
Verses.14: So then Jesus said to them plainly, "Lazarus died.
Verses.15: And, for your sakes, I'm glad that I was not there so that you may believe. Now, let us go to him."
Verses.16: Then Thomas, who is called Didymus, said to the other disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him!"
